pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20Minimal {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
}

interface IERC20Metadata {
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
}

contract MultiPoolStaking {
    uint256 public constant MAX_CAP = 1e21;
    uint256 public constant MIN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 1 hours; // 0x0e10
    uint256 public constant MIN_LOCK_PERIOD = 1 days; // 0x15180
    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_REWARD_DURATION = 30 days; // 0x278d00
    uint256 public constant ACC_PRECISION = 1e18;

    struct PoolInfo {
        address stakeToken;
        address rewardToken;
        uint256 totalStaked;
        uint256 accRewardPerShare;
        uint256 rewardDuration;
        uint256 lastUpdateTime;
        uint256 rewardRate;
        uint256 periodFinish;
        uint256 cooldownPeriod;
        uint256 lockPeriod;
        bool emergencyMode;
        uint8 feeBps;
        uint8 extraFlag;
    }

    struct UserInfo {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 rewardDebt;
        uint256 pendingRewards;
        uint256 lockEnd;
        uint256 cooldownEnd;
    }

    uint256 private _status;
    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;
    bool private _initializerOpen;
    uint256 private _poolLength;

    mapping(uint256 => PoolInfo) private _pools;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => UserInfo)) private _users;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address indexed by);
    event Unpaused(address indexed by);

    event PoolAdded(
        uint256 indexed pid,
        address indexed stakeToken,
        address indexed rewardToken,
        uint256 cooldownPeriod,
        uint256 lockPeriod
    );
    event PoolCooldownUpdated(uint256 indexed pid, uint256 newCooldown);
    event PoolLockUpdated(uint256 indexed pid, uint256 newLockPeriod);
    event PoolEmergencyModeUpdated(uint256 indexed pid, bool enabled);

    event RewardNotified(uint256 indexed pid, uint256 reward, uint256 duration);
    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 indexed pid, uint256 amount);
    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 indexed pid, uint256 amount);
    event Claimed(address indexed user, uint256 indexed pid, uint256 amount);
    event EmergencyWithdraw(address indexed user, uint256 indexed pid, uint256 amount);
    event RescueReward(address indexed by, uint256 indexed pid, uint256 amount);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = 2;
        _;
        _status = 1;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _status = 1;
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _initializerOpen = true;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function poolLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _poolLength;
    }

    function maxRewardCap() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return MAX_CAP;
    }

    function maxStakeCap() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return MAX_CAP;
    }

    function minCooldown() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return MIN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD;
    }

    function minLockPeriod() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return MIN_LOCK_PERIOD;
    }

    function setPaused(bool value) external onlyOwner {
        _paused = value;
        if (value) emit Paused(msg.sender);
        else emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function initializeOwner(address newOwner) external {
        require(_initializerOpen, "Initializer disabled");
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
        _initializerOpen = false;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function addPool(
        address stakeToken,
        address rewardToken,
        uint256 cooldownPeriod,
        uint256 lockPeriod
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(cooldownPeriod >= MIN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD, "Cooldown too short");
        require(lockPeriod >= MIN_LOCK_PERIOD, "Lock too short");

        _validateToken(stakeToken);
        _validateToken(rewardToken);

        uint256 pid = _poolLength;
        _poolLength = pid + 1;

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        p.stakeToken = stakeToken;
        p.rewardToken = rewardToken;
        p.rewardDuration = DEFAULT_REWARD_DURATION;
        p.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp;
        p.periodFinish = block.timestamp;
        p.cooldownPeriod = cooldownPeriod;
        p.lockPeriod = lockPeriod;
        p.emergencyMode = false;

        emit PoolAdded(pid, stakeToken, rewardToken, cooldownPeriod, lockPeriod);
    }

    function setPoolCooldown(uint256 pid, uint256 newCooldown) external onlyOwner {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(newCooldown >= MIN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD, "Cooldown too short");
        _pools[pid].cooldownPeriod = newCooldown;
        emit PoolCooldownUpdated(pid, newCooldown);
    }

    function setPoolLockPeriod(uint256 pid, uint256 newLockPeriod) external onlyOwner {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(newLockPeriod >= MIN_LOCK_PERIOD, "Lock too short");
        _pools[pid].lockPeriod = newLockPeriod;
        emit PoolLockUpdated(pid, newLockPeriod);
    }

    function enableEmergencyMode(uint256 pid) external onlyOwner {
        _requirePool(pid);
        _pools[pid].emergencyMode = true;
        emit PoolEmergencyModeUpdated(pid, true);
    }

    function disableEmergencyMode(uint256 pid) external onlyOwner {
        _requirePool(pid);
        _pools[pid].emergencyMode = false;
        emit PoolEmergencyModeUpdated(pid, false);
    }

    function notifyRewardAmount(uint256 pid, uint256 reward, uint256 duration) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(reward > 0, "Cannot add 0 rewards");
        require(reward <= MAX_CAP, "Reward amount exceeds cap");
        require(duration >= MIN_LOCK_PERIOD, "Duration too short");

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        _updatePool(pid);

        if (block.timestamp >= p.periodFinish) {
            p.rewardRate = reward / duration;
        } else {
            uint256 remaining = p.periodFinish - block.timestamp;
            uint256 leftover = remaining * p.rewardRate;
            p.rewardRate = (reward + leftover) / duration;
        }

        p.rewardDuration = duration;
        p.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp;
        p.periodFinish = block.timestamp + duration;

        uint256 beforeBal = _balanceOf(p.rewardToken, address(this));
        _safeTransferFrom(p.rewardToken, msg.sender, address(this), reward);
        uint256 afterBal = _balanceOf(p.rewardToken, address(this));
        require(afterBal == beforeBal + reward, "Fee on transfer not supported");

        emit RewardNotified(pid, reward, duration);
    }

    function stake(uint256 pid, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        _stake(pid, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function deposit(uint256 pid, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        _stake(pid, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 pid, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        _withdraw(pid, msg.sender, amount, true, true);
    }

    function withdrawAll(uint256 pid) external nonReentrant {
        _requirePool(pid);
        uint256 amount = _users[pid][msg.sender].amount;
        require(amount > 0, "No stake to withdraw");
        _withdraw(pid, msg.sender, amount, true, true);
    }

    function claim(uint256 pid) external nonReentrant {
        _claim(pid, msg.sender, true);
    }

    function harvest(uint256 pid) external nonReentrant {
        _claim(pid, msg.sender, true);
    }

    function exit(uint256 pid) external nonReentrant {
        _requirePool(pid);
        _claim(pid, msg.sender, false);
        uint256 amount = _users[pid][msg.sender].amount;
        if (amount > 0) {
            _withdraw(pid, msg.sender, amount, true, true);
        }
    }

    function emergencyWithdraw(uint256 pid) external nonReentrant {
        _requirePool(pid);

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][msg.sender];

        uint256 amount = u.amount;
        require(amount > 0, "No stake to withdraw");

        u.amount = 0;
        u.rewardDebt = 0;
        u.pendingRewards = 0;
        u.lockEnd = 0;
        u.cooldownEnd = 0;

        p.totalStaked -= amount;
        _safeTransfer(p.stakeToken, msg.sender, amount);

        emit EmergencyWithdraw(msg.sender, pid, amount);
    }

    function rescueRewardToken(uint256 pid, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(amount > 0, "Cannot withdraw 0");
        require(_pools[pid].emergencyMode, "Emergency mode disabled");

        _safeTransfer(_pools[pid].rewardToken, msg.sender, amount);
        emit RescueReward(msg.sender, pid, amount);
    }

    function pendingReward(uint256 pid, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        _requirePool(pid);

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];

        uint256 acc = p.accRewardPerShare;
        uint256 applicable = block.timestamp < p.periodFinish ? block.timestamp : p.periodFinish;

        if (applicable > p.lastUpdateTime && p.totalStaked > 0) {
            uint256 delta = applicable - p.lastUpdateTime;
            acc += (delta * p.rewardRate * ACC_PRECISION) / p.totalStaked;
        }

        uint256 accumulated = (u.amount * acc) / ACC_PRECISION;
        uint256 newlyAccrued = accumulated > u.rewardDebt ? accumulated - u.rewardDebt : 0;

        return u.pendingRewards + newlyAccrued;
    }

    function pendingRewards(uint256 pid, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return pendingReward(pid, account);
    }

    function earned(uint256 pid) external view returns (uint256) {
        return pendingReward(pid, msg.sender);
    }

    function claimable(uint256 pid, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return pendingReward(pid, account);
    }

    function maxWithdrawable(uint256 pid) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requirePool(pid);
        return _users[pid][msg.sender].amount;
    }

    function previewWithdraw(uint256 pid, uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requirePool(pid);
        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        uint256 fee = (amount * uint256(p.feeBps)) / 10000;
        return amount - fee;
    }

    function nextRewardTime(uint256 pid) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requirePool(pid);
        uint256 finish = _pools[pid].periodFinish;
        return finish > block.timestamp ? finish : block.timestamp;
    }

    function rewardPerToken(uint256 pid) external view returns (uint256) {
        _requirePool(pid);

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        if (p.totalStaked == 0) return p.accRewardPerShare;

        uint256 applicable = block.timestamp < p.periodFinish ? block.timestamp : p.periodFinish;
        if (applicable <= p.lastUpdateTime) return p.accRewardPerShare;

        uint256 delta = applicable - p.lastUpdateTime;
        return p.accRewardPerShare + ((delta * p.rewardRate * ACC_PRECISION) / p.totalStaked);
    }

    function userInfo(uint256 pid, address account)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 amount,
            uint256 rewardDebt,
            uint256 pending,
            uint256 lockEnd,
            uint256 cooldownEnd
        )
    {
        _requirePool(pid);
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];
        return (u.amount, u.rewardDebt, u.pendingRewards, u.lockEnd, u.cooldownEnd);
    }

    function userInfoWithPending(uint256 pid, address account)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 amount,
            uint256 rewardDebt,
            uint256 pending,
            uint256 lockEnd,
            uint256 cooldownEnd
        )
    {
        _requirePool(pid);
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];
        return (u.amount, u.rewardDebt, pendingReward(pid, account), u.lockEnd, u.cooldownEnd);
    }

    function poolInfo(uint256 pid)
        external
        view
        returns (
            address stakeToken,
            address rewardToken,
            uint256 totalStaked,
            uint256 accRewardPerShare,
            uint256 rewardDuration,
            uint256 lastUpdateTime,
            uint256 rewardRate,
            uint256 periodFinish,
            uint256 cooldownPeriod,
            uint256 lockPeriod,
            bool emergencyMode,
            uint8 feeBps,
            uint8 extraFlag
        )
    {
        _requirePool(pid);
        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        return (
            p.stakeToken,
            p.rewardToken,
            p.totalStaked,
            p.accRewardPerShare,
            p.rewardDuration,
            p.lastUpdateTime,
            p.rewardRate,
            p.periodFinish,
            p.cooldownPeriod,
            p.lockPeriod,
            p.emergencyMode,
            p.feeBps,
            p.extraFlag
        );
    }

    function _stake(uint256 pid, address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(amount > 0, "Cannot stake 0");
        require(amount <= MAX_CAP, "Amount exceeds cap");

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        require(!p.emergencyMode, "Pool in emergency mode");

        _accrue(pid, account);

        uint256 beforeBal = _balanceOf(p.stakeToken, address(this));
        _safeTransferFrom(p.stakeToken, account, address(this), amount);
        uint256 afterBal = _balanceOf(p.stakeToken, address(this));
        require(afterBal == beforeBal + amount, "Fee on transfer not supported");

        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];
        u.amount += amount;
        p.totalStaked += amount;

        u.lockEnd = block.timestamp + p.lockPeriod;
        u.cooldownEnd = block.timestamp + p.cooldownPeriod;
        u.rewardDebt = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_PRECISION;

        emit Staked(account, pid, amount);
    }

    function _withdraw(
        uint256 pid,
        address account,
        uint256 amount,
        bool checkLock,
        bool checkCooldown
    ) internal {
        _requirePool(pid);
        require(amount > 0, "Cannot withdraw 0");

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];

        _accrue(pid, account);

        if (checkLock) {
            require(block.timestamp >= u.lockEnd, "Lock period active");
        }
        if (checkCooldown) {
            require(block.timestamp >= u.cooldownEnd, "Cooldown period active");
        }

        require(u.amount >= amount, "Insufficient balance");

        u.amount -= amount;
        p.totalStaked -= amount;
        u.rewardDebt = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_PRECISION;

        _safeTransferOutChecked(p.stakeToken, account, amount);
        emit Withdrawn(account, pid, amount);
    }

    function _claim(uint256 pid, address account, bool enforceCooldown) internal returns (uint256 reward) {
        _requirePool(pid);

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];

        _accrue(pid, account);

        if (enforceCooldown) {
            require(block.timestamp >= u.cooldownEnd, "Cooldown period active");
        }

        reward = u.pendingRewards;
        if (reward == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        u.pendingRewards = 0;
        _safeTransferOutChecked(p.rewardToken, account, reward);

        emit Claimed(account, pid, reward);
    }

    function _updatePool(uint256 pid) internal {
        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];

        uint256 applicable = block.timestamp < p.periodFinish ? block.timestamp : p.periodFinish;
        if (applicable <= p.lastUpdateTime) return;

        if (p.totalStaked > 0 && p.rewardRate > 0) {
            uint256 delta = applicable - p.lastUpdateTime;
            p.accRewardPerShare += (delta * p.rewardRate * ACC_PRECISION) / p.totalStaked;
        }

        p.lastUpdateTime = applicable;
    }

    function _accrue(uint256 pid, address account) internal {
        _updatePool(pid);

        PoolInfo storage p = _pools[pid];
        UserInfo storage u = _users[pid][account];

        if (u.amount > 0) {
            uint256 accumulated = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_PRECISION;
            if (accumulated > u.rewardDebt) {
                u.pendingRewards += (accumulated - u.rewardDebt);
            }
        }

        u.rewardDebt = (u.amount * p.accRewardPerShare) / ACC_PRECISION;
    }

    function _requirePool(uint256 pid) internal view {
        require(pid < _poolLength && _pools[pid].stakeToken != address(0), "Invalid pool");
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token, address account) internal view returns (uint256 bal) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.balanceOf.selector, account));
        require(ok && data.length >= 32, "Invalid token: balanceOf");
        bal = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(_didReturnTrue(ok, data), "ERC20 transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value));
        require(_didReturnTrue(ok, data), "ERC20 transferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferOutChecked(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        uint256 beforeBal = _balanceOf(token, address(this));
        _safeTransfer(token, to, value);
        uint256 afterBal = _balanceOf(token, address(this));
        require(beforeBal == afterBal + value, "Fee on transfer not supported");
    }

    function _validateToken(address token) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "Zero address");

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Metadata.decimals.selector));
        require(ok && data.length >= 32, "Invalid token: decimals");

        uint256 d = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        require(d == 18, "Invalid token: decimals");

        (ok, data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transfer.selector, address(this), 0));
        require(_didReturnTrue(ok, data), "Invalid token: transfer");

        (ok, data) =
            token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, address(this), address(this), 0));
        require(_didReturnTrue(ok, data), "Invalid token: transferFrom");
    }

    function _didReturnTrue(bool ok, bytes memory data) internal pure returns (bool) {
        if (!ok) return false;
        if (data.length == 0) return true;
        if (data.length < 32) return false;
        uint256 v = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        return v == 1;
    }
}

            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 ||
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7;

    }

        return _tokenSymbol;
    }

        return tokenOwner;
    }

        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;

        for (uint256 tokenId = 0; tokenId < _currentIndex; tokenId++) {
            if (_owners[tokenId] == tokenOwner) {
                if (found == index) return tokenId;

        _saleConfig.publicPrice = publicPrice_;
        _saleConfig.maxPerWallet = maxPerWallet_;

        require(msg.value >= cost, "insufficient funds");

        _mint(msg.sender, quantity);

        require(msg.value >= cost, "insufficient funds");

        _balances[to] += quantity;
        _minted[to] += quantity;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {

            _owners[tokenId] = to;
            _ownershipStartTimestamp[tokenId] = uint64(block.timestamp);

        _ownershipStartTimestamp[tokenId] = uint64(block.timestamp);

        return block.timestamp <= _saleConfig.saleEnd;
    }

    function _setPublicPrice(uint256 price) internal {
        _checkOwner();
        _saleConfig.publicPrice = price;
    }

    function _setMerkleRoot(bytes32 root) internal {
        _checkOwner();
        _legacyMerkleRoot = root;
    }

    function _setSaleConfig(uint32 proofSalt_, uint32 saleEnd_, uint256 price_, uint256 maxPerWallet_) internal {
        _checkOwner();
        _saleConfig.proofSalt = proofSalt_;
        _saleConfig.saleEnd = saleEnd_;
        _saleConfig.publicPrice = price_;
        _saleConfig.maxPerWallet = maxPerWallet_;
    }

    function _setBaseURI(string memory uri) internal {
        _checkOwner();
        _baseTokenURI = uri;
    }

    function _setProofSalt(uint32 proofSalt_) internal {
        _checkOwner();
        _saleConfig.proofSalt = proofSalt_;
    }

    function _setSaleEnd(uint32 saleEnd_) internal {

        _saleConfig.saleEnd = saleEnd_;
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {

        _owner = newOwner;

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _verifyProof(bytes32[] memory proof, bytes32 root, bytes32 leaf) internal pure returns (bool) {

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            if (computed <= p) {

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20 {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
}

contract JurisdictionComplianceController {
    struct WalletData {
        uint256 received;
        uint256 sent;
        uint256 pending;
        uint256 lockUntil;
    }

    struct Vesting {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 due;
    }

    bool private _initialized;
    bool private _initializing;

    address private _owner;
    mapping(address => bool) private _operators;

    address public paymentToken;            // slot 0x99 (approx)
    uint256 public startDate;               // slot 0x9a
    uint256 public minRequiredBalance;      // slot 0x9b
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public haltDueById; // slot 0xa0
    uint256 public maxInvestors;            // slot 0xa1
    uint256 public investorCount;           // slot 0xa2
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public phaseById;   // slot 0xa3
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public quotaById;   // slot 0xa4

    mapping(address => uint8) public walletFlags;   // slot 0xa5 (bit0 = active)
    mapping(address => uint256) public walletScore; // slot 0xa6
    mapping(address => uint8) public walletStatus;  // slot 0xa7
    mapping(address => address) public linkedWallet;// slot 0xa8

    mapping(address => address) public walletOf;    // slot 0x9d
    mapping(address => uint256) public walletMeta;  // slot 0x9e

    mapping(address => WalletData) private _walletData;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => Vesting)) private _history;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _historyCount;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _jurisdictionFlow;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _table;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event OperatorGranted(address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event OperatorRevoked(address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    event WalletLinked(address indexed wallet, address indexed canonical, address indexed sender);
    event WalletActivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed sender);
    event WalletDeactivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed sender);

    event FlowRuleSet(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 allowance_);
    event FlowProcessed(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint8 code);

    event VestingAdded(address indexed wallet, uint256 amount, uint256 due, uint256 index);
    event HaltSet(uint256 indexed key, uint256 due);
    event HaltCleared(uint256 indexed key);
    event ConfigUpdated(uint256 startDate, uint256 minRequiredBalance);
    event TokenConfigured(address indexed token);

    modifier initializer() {
        require(_initializing || !_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        bool top = !_initializing;
        if (top) {
            _initializing = true;
            _initialized = true;
        }
        _;
        if (top) {
            _initializing = false;
        }
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperator() {
        require(_operators[msg.sender], "OperatorRole: caller does not have the Operator role");
        _;
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert("NO_ETHER");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert("INVALID_SELECTOR");
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _setOwner(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        _setOwner(address(0));
    }

    function _setOwner(address newOwner) internal {
        address prev = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(prev, newOwner);
    }

    function _initialize(address token_) internal {
        _setOwner(msg.sender);
        paymentToken = token_;
        emit TokenConfigured(token_);
    }

    function _walletActive(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return (walletFlags[account] & 1) == 1;
    }

    function _grantOperator(address account) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "Roles: account is the zero address");
        require(!_operators[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _operators[account] = true;
        emit OperatorGranted(account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeOperator(address account) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "Roles: account is the zero address");
        require(_operators[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _operators[account] = false;
        emit OperatorRevoked(account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _activateWallet(address wallet) internal {
        require(wallet != address(0), "ZERO_ADDRESS");
        require(!_walletActive(wallet), "ALREADY_ACTIVATED_WALLET");
        if (maxInvestors != 0) {
            require(investorCount < maxInvestors, "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS");
        }
        walletFlags[wallet] |= 1;
        walletStatus[wallet] = 1;
        investorCount += 1;
        emit WalletActivated(wallet, msg.sender);
    }

    function _deactivateWallet(address wallet) internal {
        require(_walletActive(wallet), "ALREADY_DEACTIVATED_WALLET");
        walletFlags[wallet] &= ~uint8(1);
        walletStatus[wallet] = 0;
        if (investorCount > 0) investorCount -= 1;
        emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, msg.sender);
    }

    function _statusMessage(uint8 code) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (code == 0) return "SUCCESS";
        if (code == 1) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_FLOW";
        if (code == 2) return "DENIED: LOCKUP";
        if (code == 3) return "DENIED: INVALID_WALLET";
        if (code == 4) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_HALT";
        return "DENIED: UNKNOWN_REASON";
    }

    function _flowStatus(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint8) {
        if (from == address(0) || to == address(0)) return 3;
        if (!_walletActive(from) || !_walletActive(to)) return 3;

        uint256 fromHalt = haltDueById[uint256(uint160(from))];
        uint256 toHalt = haltDueById[uint256(uint160(to))];
        if ((fromHalt != 0 && block.timestamp >= fromHalt) || (toHalt != 0 && block.timestamp >= toHalt)) return 4;

        if (_walletData[from].lockUntil > block.timestamp || _walletData[to].lockUntil > block.timestamp) return 2;

        uint256 allowed = _jurisdictionFlow[from][to];
        if (allowed < amount) return 1;

        return 0;
    }

    function _appendVesting(address wallet, uint256 amount, uint256 due) internal {
        uint256 idx = _historyCount[wallet];
        _history[wallet][idx] = Vesting(amount, due);
        _historyCount[wallet] = idx + 1;
        walletScore[wallet] = idx + 1;

        _walletData[wallet].pending += amount;
        emit VestingAdded(wallet, amount, due, idx);
    }

    function _consumeUnlocked(address wallet, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(_walletData[wallet].pending >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");

        uint256 remaining = amount;
        uint256 len = _historyCount[wallet];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len && remaining > 0; ) {
            Vesting storage v = _history[wallet][i];
            if (v.amount != 0 && (v.due == 0 || v.due <= block.timestamp)) {
                uint256 take = v.amount < remaining ? v.amount : remaining;
                v.amount -= take;
                remaining -= take;
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }

        require(remaining == 0, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
        _walletData[wallet].pending -= amount;
        _walletData[wallet].sent += amount;
    }

    function _requireZeroBalance(address account) internal view {
        require(paymentToken != address(0), "TOKEN_NOT_SET");
        require(IERC20(paymentToken).balanceOf(account) == 0, "ACCOUNT_HAS_TOKEN_BALANCE");
    }

    function _processFlow(address from, address to, uint256 amount, bool strict_) internal returns (uint8 code) {
        code = _flowStatus(from, to, amount);
        if (strict_) {
            require(code == 0, _statusMessage(code));
        }
        if (code != 0) {
            emit FlowProcessed(from, to, amount, code);
            return code;
        }

        uint256 allowed = _jurisdictionFlow[from][to];
        if (allowed != type(uint256).max) {
            _jurisdictionFlow[from][to] = allowed - amount;
        }

        _walletData[from].sent += amount;
        _walletData[to].received += amount;
        uint256 due = minRequiredBalance == 0 ? 0 : block.timestamp + minRequiredBalance;
        _appendVesting(to, amount, due);

        emit FlowProcessed(from, to, amount, 0);
    }

    // 0xc4d66de8
    function fn_c4d66de8(address token_) external initializer {
        _initialize(token_);
    }

    // Optional alias
    function initialize(address token_) external initializer {
        _initialize(token_);
    }

    // 0x2ab6f8db
    function fn_2ab6f8db() external {
        _grantOperator(msg.sender);
    }

    // 0xac8a584a
    function fn_ac8a584a(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _grantOperator(account);
    }

    // 0x9870d7fe
    function fn_9870d7fe(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _revokeOperator(account);
    }

    // 0x6d70f7ae
    function fn_6d70f7ae(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _operators[account];
    }

    // 0x8f32d59b
    function fn_8f32d59b() external view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }

    // 0x8da5cb5b
    function fn_8da5cb5b() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    // 0xf2fde38b
    function fn_f2fde38b(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    // 0x715018a6
    function fn_715018a6() external onlyOwner {
        renounceOwnership();
    }

    // 0x16f3b322
    function fn_16f3b322(address[] calldata wallets, address[] calldata canonicals) external onlyOperator {
        require(wallets.length == canonicals.length, "LENGTH_MISMATCH");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; ) {
            address w = wallets[i];
            address c = canonicals[i];
            require(w != address(0) && c != address(0), "ZERO_ADDRESS");
            require(walletOf[w] == address(0), "USER_WALLET_ALREADY_ADDED");

            linkedWallet[c] = w;

            }

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }
